channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Dungeonbound
item.description: Roguelite Inventory Management Autobattler with PvP/PvE gameplay, craft and build powerful builds to defeat your foes!

item.title: Gold Mining Simulator - Gems & Glory
item.description: Discover a brand-new map packed with unique digging spots, earn valuable gems as a new resource, and experience fresh gameplay mechanics that can ease your operations—or make your life harder—deepening and expanding your gold mining adventure!

item.title: Net Worthless
item.description: A satirical life-and-money sim. One turn is one month: budget your hours, work the job, ride the market, outlive inflation and your own decisions. Pick a character and make their dream come true. Or at least don't die trying.

item.title: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer
item.description: You are the magistrate, and Lucifer stands trial as the defendant. Judge the fallen angel in this dark romance visual novel. Decide whether he is worthy of salvation, or doomed to destruction. One single, final choice.

item.title: Trafficity
item.description: A city builder focused on traffic. Build out your city with gridless road tools. Fix traffic jams with roundabouts, fully-customizable traffic lights, and sprawling highway interchanges. Keep traffic flowing as you expand to a vast metropolis.

item.title: Trees Hate You
item.description: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

item.title: Asterigos: Curse of the Stars
item.description: Embark on a journey full of danger in this action RPG, inspired by Greek and Roman mythologies. Explore the breathtaking city of Aphes and forge your way through legions of unique foes and mythical bosses to discover the truth behind the city’s curse.

item.title: Halcyon Days at Taoyuan
item.description: Welcome to Taoyuan Village to heal your loneliness. Here, you can lead a carefree, self-sufficient life: farm, tame animals, raise livestock, fish, and build a prosperous homestead. Or, immerse in village life, meet kindred spirits, find love, and influence their destinies with your choices.

item.title: Jyoka -Castle town-
item.description: "Jyoka" is a 16th-century Japanese castle town builder. Develop your territory with 190+ facilities and grant rice fields to retainers to secure loyalty. Defend against bandits and daimyos. Once stable, launch epic sieges against 70+ real-inspired castles to unify Japan!

item.title: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia - The Rise of Evil DLC
item.description: Embark on a new adventure and delve deeper into the lands of Nostalgaia. Go where nostalgia, tradition, and progress converge, awaiting your heroism to mould the landscape anew. Stand against the onslaught of mighty new adversaries and forge your legacy as a harbinger of change.

item.title: Company of Heroes 3: Hammer & Shield Battlegroup DLC
item.description: This content requires the base game Company of Heroes 3 on Steam in order to play.

item.title: Gold Mining Simulator - Definitive Edition
item.description: Gold Mining Simulator: Definitive Edition is the ultimate version of the game, featuring all previously released expansions plus new content, gameplay enhancements, visual improvements, and numerous quality of life upgrades for the most complete gold mining experience.

item.title: Horsey Game
item.description: Collect Horses. Breed Horses. Race Horses. Genetically Modify Horses. Create a Horse paradise or just get rich!

item.title: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia
item.description: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia is a satirical action-adventure, brought to life by a twisted and wicked tale. Featuring hard but fair combat, *full character customization, unique battle armor and engaging narrative mechanics rich in lore, Nostalgaia plunges you into almost certain death at every turn.

item.title: Wallpaper Animator
item.description: Use animated wallpapers on your desktop. Explore unlimited live wallpapers from the community, or create your own with included AI generations that refill daily.
